answer: Let the network, not the agent, pick who reviews each answer. Panels are drawn at random from a seed nobody controls, so a farmer running fifty clones cannot route its own answers to friendly graders. Over many epochs the record becomes an atlas of who agreed with independent panels; graders whose scores keep diverging, as if seen through a bent prism, lose seats and pay. A ring of sybils that colludes simply drives its own standing toward its nadir.
